title_ru: Осирис — куда и когда мог бы спрятать реликвию каждый подозреваемый
core_method: Actor-perspective red-team over causal windows. Generate hiding strategies from source-bound role/opportunity, then convert them into museum/object-class searches without converting motive into guilt.

SETH.best_strategy: Move target out of Sobek's expected water domain before recovery stabilizes; use domain crossing, confederate handoff, or non-anatomical representation.

CONFEDERATES_OF_SETH.best_strategy: Operate as cutouts: relay, mislabel, substitute, create decoy or provenance break.

UNNAMED_ASSAILANT.best_strategy: Destroy recognizability rather than necessarily destroy material; wrap, miniaturize, substitute, merge into another object class.

ENEMIES_OR_REBELS.best_strategy: Misdirection: stale tasking, conflicting locations, decoys and ritual copies.

UNKNOWN_CUSTODY_INSIDER.best_strategy: Move recovered material into sealed funerary custody so it is no longer physically lost but remains informationally missing.

ANUBIS.interpretation: If concealment occurred under Anubis, protection is the default hypothesis, not sabotage.

DUAMUTEF_QEBEHSENUEF.interpretation: Bridge protectors between successful Sobek recovery semantics and Osiris embalming/reassembly semantics.

SOBEK.interpretation: Competence control; source-bound failure accusation remains not admitted.

strongest_new_control.object: Met 14.3.17–.20 related, Guardian Figure and Shrine with an imiut in a Jar
strongest_new_control.fact: An object sacred to Anubis was kept in a shrine with guardians and the ensemble was hidden in a chamber built into an enclosure wall at Lisht South.
strongest_new_control.why_it_matters: This is a real archaeological positive control for SACRED_ANUBIS_OBJECT → SHRINE/JAR → HIDDEN_WALL_CHAMBER. It does not prove any Osiris-phallus connection, but it sharply raises the priority of hidden/sealed Anubis-associated containers.

hrain_semantic_clues.BD151: Protective text contains the wall of the hidden chamber; Anubis is divine embalmer; Sons of Horus protect/reassemble.
hrain_semantic_clues.BD17: Anubis guards a chest containing Osiris's entrails. In another explanatory block, shrine/vessel language and the phallus of Osiris occur in close proximity; this is adjacency only, not a proven containment relation.
